title: From Grid Microphysics to the Radial Acceleration Relation: A Minimal Gradient-Coupled Excitation Model
abstract: A precise structural gap exists in Energy-Flow Cosmology: the covariant EFT requires a gravitational enhancement function mu(g) = 1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1) formally identical to a Bose-Einstein occupation number, but this form cannot be derived from any classical local Lagrangian. We show that a minimal microscopic model with gradient-coupled excitation energy E proportional to sqrt(|nabla Phi|) reproduces the observed functional form without free parameters beyond the measured scale a0.
significance: Closes the microphysical gap identified in the Covariant EFT (31878334); bridges macro-framework (covariant action) to micro-interpretation (grid nodes, bosonic modes, thermodynamic occupation)
